summary: We wanted to potray the parts and the importance of every details in the Sojourner Rover- the first rover to ever land on Mars. This could help remind the younger generations or even everyone- to know- and learn more about the things that we thought had been left in the past and is useless ever since it stopped working- is an important thing that had contributed to the future and a memorable part of history.
details: This is a type of visual novel, which, you can interact in certain 2 scenes. From this, you can learn more about the history about the long-forgotten parts on Mars that even when it has stopped working, contributed a large part in our progress about finding about Mars and developing our technology. We used capcut and youtube to develop our project. The factors that our team considered was time, work.
